# University of Virginia

> The University of Virginia is a premier public research institution offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs with a focus on academic excellence, research innovation, and student life in Charlottesville.

UVA serves as a comprehensive academic hub featuring multiple schools and colleges, research institutes including the Biocomplexity Institute and Brain Institute, and a vibrant campus community. The institution maintains strong connections to its founding heritage while advancing strategic initiatives through its 2030 Plan.
